title: Axiverse Lampposts
summary: The string axiverse predicts a unique connection between the high scales approachable only through theory and the low energies within reach of experimental verification: a multitude of light, feebly interacting axions. In order to capture the collective effects of such an axion ensemble, we model the string axiverse by $N$ coupled axions with a simple assumption: hierarchical axion masses that arise from hierarchical instantons with statistically distributed axion couplings.
